# Core rules
[italic]Core rules follow the discord rules closely.[/italic]
[bold]Rule 0-1.[/bold] No hard slurs, and no targeted slurs against RL disabilities. You can't call someone retarded because you know they have autism. But calling someone a retard because they walked on a landmine or got eaten alive is acceptable. [bold]SubRule 0-1-1.[/bold] Slurs against mutated humans are acceptable, so long as it doesn't break 0-2 and is not based off of real-world slurs. [bold]SubRule 0-1-2.[/bold] Being called a slur as a mutated human is viable grounds to kill the other person, if you weren't already doing so. This applies to mutants being discriminatory against normal humans as well.
[bold]Rule 0-2.[/bold] Do not share OOC personal information about yourself or others without explicit consent. This includes addresses, phone numbers, emails, etc.
[bold]Rule 0-3.[/bold] No NSFW content is allowed. Anyone caught performing ERP will be punished.
[bold]Rule 0-4.[/bold] If you see someone breaking a core rule, report it and it will be taken care of.
[bold]Rule 0-5.[/bold] English is the preferred language, you are allowed to speak in your native tongue, but refusing to speak English at all is liable for punishment. In Ahelps you are expected to know fundamental English to communicate your case.
[bold]Rule 0-6.[/bold] The dreaded good faith rule. Don't abuse the AI and don't intentionally make the game unplayable for others.
[italic]Violating these rules may result in a warning, mute, kick, or ban, depending on the severity of the violation. In the case of ERP, usage of real-world slurs, and leaking personal info, it is an appeal only ban.[/italic]
# Combat Rules.
[italic]Combat rules apply to interactions that result in bloodshed amongst 2 (or more) players, not amongst NPCs and players.[/italic]
[bold][italic]Note that this is an active apocalypse, people will do horrible things and believe in what would be considered taboo today. The world is burning and we are merely trying not to be consumed by it. Desperation, debauchery, and homicide is not off the table.[/italic][/bold]
[bold]Rule 1-1.[/bold] Combat may be engaged between two (or more) players for the reasonings as follows:
[italic]Verbal attacks:[/italic] Insults and such.
[italic]Secretive actions:[/italic] If you are attempting to hide something, like a corpse, a stash, money, etc. you may kill someone who witnesses you attempting to hide such items.
[italic]Robbery/Mugging:[/italic] If you are [bold]AWARE[/bold] of an item on another person that you [bold]need[/bold] or [bold]want[/bold] then you are permitted to rob that person. [italic]How you go about this is up to player discretion,[/italic] but do note that this [bold]doesn't mean you kill a dozen people to take 1 thing.[/bold] Unless, of course, that dozen people is actively trying to stop you from taking that item.
[italic]Ideological differences:[/italic] If you are part of a [bold]faction or group[/bold] with a selective ideology or belief, you may engage other groups on the basis of their opposing ideology, once aware of it. [italic]An anarcho-capitalist group would despise a group trying to impose fascist authoritarianism upon the area. And would gladly engage and kill them for such.[/italic]
[italic]Known actions:[/italic] If you know a person or persons are committing heinous acts, such as cannibalism, genocide, omnicide, serial killings, and/or speaks of "rape" or "molested", you may kill that person if you are not a teammate to them.
[italic]This list is not exhaustive. There is multiple reasons why someone would kill another in this world.[/italic]
[bold]Rule 1-2.[/bold] Ambush combat, an ambush can be done by anyone against anyone. [italic]Nobody is safe from being ambushed, no matter their role or faction.[/italic]
[bold]Rule 1-2-1.[/bold] An ambush isn’t sitting in a bush for 30 minutes or corner camping a door. Set up a trap, a barricade, some form of prep work. Just be creative! [bold]Running up behind someone and shooting them in the back is not an ambush, that is just homicide.[/bold]
[bold]Rule 1-3.[/bold] Base assaults can be conducted at any time, so long as [bold]Rule 1-1[/bold] is fulfilled. No you cannot ambush a base, but you are allowed to set up an ambush outside of one. [italic]Certain locations may or may not be valid for assaults and raids. It is recommended to ask and be sure before you blaze in and cop a ban. Generally: player built bases are valid.[/italic]
# Roleplay rules.
[italic]These aren't really rules, just fundamentals.[/italic]
[bold][italic]Note that people will go mad upon watching all they took for granted burn before them. Psychopaths, madmen, and the delusional are not out of the picture.[/italic][/bold]
[bold]Rule 2-1.[/bold] Your character is a reasonable human being. Having some moderate insanity, psychosis, obsession, or apathetic/psychopathic behavior is considered acceptable within CDDA lore and the current situation. No this does not supersede [bold]Rule 1-1[/bold]. It only helps with the larp that comes afterwards and the reasoning beforehand. The excuse "but my character is a psycho" is not sufficient to kill 5 people without a word or prior knowledge.
[bold]Rule 2-2.[/bold] Act in character at all times. Breaking character alone is grounds to be banned. True roleplay comes when the setting is taken seriously and the characters act within the confines of it. [italic]Using LOOC to talk a little outside of character is fine, especially to teach others the game! But using it to argue about something that happened in character is foolish, and doesn't do anything but subtract from the experience.[/italic]
[bold]Rule 2-3.[/bold] Respect the setting of CDDA and act within it, not outside of it. This is a apocalypse where the world is overtaken by inter dimensional goo, aliens are landing on earth, mutant humans exist, and there is cyborgs coming through portals. [italic]Is it a little goofy? Yes. Does it take this seriously and will off you for making light of it? Yes.[/italic]
[bold]Rule 2-4.[/bold] Player made factions can follow borderline any ideology they desire, or lack one entirely! So long as the ideology doesn't break core rules, roleplay rules, or looks to break combat rules, you are entirely fine to play with this faction and larp it out in game!
[bold]Rule 2-5.[/bold] Use a realistic full name.
[italic]These rules act as the core of what I will look to enforce. I couldn't give less of a fuck about dead sprites, I value the quality of your larp significantly more. LRP shit will be punished.[/italic]
[bold]Rule 2-6.[/bold] Metacomming is prohibited. No Metacomming. Literally 1984. Do note that if we suspect you are using ghosts to feed you info in game, [bold][italic]both of you will be banned.[/italic][/bold]
[bold]Rule 2-7.[/bold] NLR rules, so dreaded and so restrictive. There is 2 kinds of death, Temporary Death and True Death. The subrules will explain this better. We use a softer form of NLR.
[bold]Rule 2-7-1.[/bold] [italic]True Death[/italic] is when your player instance, or character, has died and you RESPAWN. Under true death, you do not remember [italic]anything from the interaction that killed you. Including location, items on your person, the person(s) that killed you, or the weapon used.[/italic] However, you do remember your friends and faction loyalty.
[bold]Rule 2-7-2.[/bold] [italic]Temporary Death[/italic] is when your player instance, or character, has died but you have been REVIVED in the same instance. Under temporary death you remember [italic]the person(s) that killed you, the location, what you had on you, but not what was used to kill you.[/italic] Like with true death, you still remember your friends and faction loyalty.
